what: The section is pinned to the screen (for screen height × 2), and five horizontal bands, starting from the bottom one and moving up with a .107 stagger, each open vertically from the center (scaleY 0 → 1, .43) to cover the section — tied to scroll (scrub, no curve), so they fold back when rewound. When fully covered, fx:covered fires. look: gradient — the five bands share one gradient, becoming a seamless plate once covered (a curtain that continues into the next section’s background)

options.each: Length one row opens up (timeline units), default .43
options.length: Fixed scroll length (multiple of screen height), default 2 — original application section 1.6
options.pin: if false, no pinning, while the section scrolls past
options.look: gradient — each row paints its own share of one gradient (--fx-stripe-fill). Default is a solid color (--fx-stripe-color, or the accent color if unset)
options.data-fx-part=\"stripe\": If you place your own line it uses that (otherwise the part creates one)

from.where: index.html concept → speaker transition (solid blue, 2x) · before the application oval (blue → sky → gray gradient, 1.6x) — original mc · hc: order [4,3,2,1,0] .43 · .107
